changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce call_log provider at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_call_log ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_call_log_provider CHECK (provider IN ('EXOTEL'))

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce call_log direction at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_call_log ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_call_log_direction CHECK (direction IS NULL OR direction IN ('OUTBOUND', 'INBOUND'))

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce call_log source at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_call_log ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_call_log_source CHECK (source IS NULL OR source IN ('CRM', 'API'))

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce call_log status at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_call_log ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_call_log_status CHECK (status IS NULL OR status IN ('QUEUED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'BUSY', 'NO_ANSWER'))
